```{r make data, echo=FALSE}
  psun = read.csv("expression/psun.csv")
  ovis = read.csv("expression/ovis.csv")
  athal = read.csv("expression/athal.csv")
  cjap = read.csv("expression/cjap.csv")
  n2a = read.csv("expression/n2a.csv")
  
  sampleTable <- read.csv("expression/sampletree_2.csv", row.names = 1)
  
  
test <- read.delim(file='Orthogroups.tsv')

ogs <- melt(test, id = "Orthogroup")

ogs$value <- tolower(ogs$value)

ogs <- ogs |>
  separate_rows(value, sep = ", ")

colnames(ogs) <- c("Family", "Species", "Gene")

psun$X <- tolower(psun$X)
psun <- psun %>%
  group_by(X) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(psun) <- psun$X
psun <- psun[,-1]
psun <- t(scale(t(psun)))
psun <- na.omit(psun)

ovis$X <- tolower(ovis$X)
ovis <- ovis %>%
  group_by(X) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(ovis) <- ovis$X
ovis <- ovis[,-1]
ovis <- t(scale(t(ovis)))
ovis <- na.omit(ovis)




cjap$X <- tolower(cjap$X)
cjap <- cjap %>%
  group_by(X) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(cjap) <- cjap$X
cjap <- cjap[,-1]
cjap <- t(scale(t(cjap)))
cjap <- na.omit(cjap)
cjap <- na.omit(cjap)

athal$X <- tolower(athal$X)
athal <- athal %>%
  group_by(X) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum)) %>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(athal) <- athal$X
athal <- athal[,-1]
athal <- t(scale(t(athal)))
athal <- na.omit(athal)
athal <- filter_by_variance(athal, percentile = 0.5)

n2a$X <- tolower(n2a$X)
n2a <- n2a %>%
  group_by(X) %>%
  summarise(across(where(is.numeric), sum))%>%
  as.data.frame()
rownames(n2a) <- n2a$X
n2a <- n2a[,-1]
n2a <- t(scale(t(n2a)))
n2a <- na.omit(n2a)



ogs <- ogs |>
  mutate(Gene = trimws(Gene)) |>
  filter(Gene != "")

explist <- list(psun = psun, ovis = ovis, cjap = cjap, n2a = n2a, athal = athal)

exp_ortho <- exp_genes2orthogroups(explist, ogs, summarize = "mean")

# exp_ortho is a list of species matrices
og_lists <- lapply(exp_ortho, rownames)

list2env(exp_ortho,envir=.GlobalEnv)

psun$rn <- rownames(psun)
ovis$rn <- rownames(ovis)
athal$rn <- rownames(athal)
cjap$rn <- rownames(cjap)
n2a$rn <- rownames(n2a)


expr <- full_join(psun, cjap)
expr <- full_join(expr, ovis)
expr <- full_join(expr, n2a)
expr <- full_join(expr, athal)

rownames(expr) <- expr$rn
expr$rn <- NULL

expr[is.na(expr)] <- 0
expr <- na.omit(expr)

dups <- duplicated(expr) 
expr <- expr[!duplicated(expr),]


nexpr <- t(expr)
nexpr <- as.data.frame(nexpr)


conditions1 = unique(sampleTable[,2])
conditions2 = unique(sampleTable[,3])


se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(expr = as.matrix(expr)),
  colData = sampleTable
)
```

```{r scale-free topology, echo=FALSE}

# Choose a set of soft-thresholding powers
powers = c(c(1:10), seq(from = 12, to=20, by=2))
# Call the network topology analysis function
sft = pickSoftThreshold(nexpr, powerVector = powers, verbose = 5)
# Plot the results:
sizeGrWindow(9, 5)
par(mfrow = c(1,2));
cex1 = 0.9;
# Scale-free topology fit index as a function of the soft-thresholding power
plot(sft$fitIndices[,1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3])*sft$fitIndices[,2],
xlab="Soft Threshold (power)",ylab="Scale Free Topology Model Fit,signed R^2",type="n",
main = paste("Scale independence"))
text(sft$fitIndices[,1], -sign(sft$fitIndices[,3])*sft$fitIndices[,2],
labels=powers,cex=cex1,col="red")
# this line corresponds to using an R^2 cut-off of h
abline(h=0.90,col="red")
```

PLotting module flow

```{r plot flow, echo=TRUE}


TOMFlowPlot2 = function(WGCNAlist, networks, toms, genes_to_label, alpha = 0.1, color = 'black', width = 0.05){
  
  stopifnot(length(networks) == 2)
  stopifnot(length(toms) == 2)
  stopifnot(length(genes_to_label) > 0)
  
  # Read in files (equivalent to object@datExpr slot of WGCNA object)
  datasets = WGCNAlist[networks]
  
  # Make common list of genes
  allCommonGenes=datasets[[1]]@datExpr$X[order(datasets[[1]]@datExpr$X)]
  
  # First extract the order from hierarchical clustering of TOM dissimilarity matrix
  orderList=list()
  positionList=list()
  for(element in seq_along(networks)){
    
    # Get TOM
    TOM=toms[[element]]
    dissTOM=1-TOM
    
    # Cluster TOM
    message("Clustering TOM tree ", element, "...")
    geneTree = flashClust(as.dist(dissTOM), method="average")
    
    # Compile data
    geneOrder=data.frame(Gene=datasets[[element]]@datExpr$X[geneTree$order], 
                         Color=datasets[[element]]@datExpr$dynamicColors[geneTree$order])
    geneOrder$order=1:length(allCommonGenes)
    sortedOrder=geneOrder[order(geneOrder$Gene),]
    orderList[[element]]=sortedOrder
  }
  
  # Combine results
  df=do.call(cbind, orderList)
  colnames(df)=c("one.gene","one.color", "one.order", "two.gene", "two.color", "two.order")
  df$Count=1
  head(df)
  df$one.gene=paste0("1_", df$one.gene)
  df$one.gene=factor(df$one.gene, levels=df$one.gene[order(df$one.order)])
  df$two.gene=paste0("2_", df$two.gene)
  df$two.gene=factor(df$two.gene, levels=df$two.gene[order(df$two.order)])
  colors=c(rev(df$one.color[order(df$one.order)]), rev(df$two.color[order(df$two.order)]))
  
  # Choose module to label
  df$module="other"
df$module[df$one.gene %in% paste0("1_", genes_to_label)] = "labeled"
  df$module = factor(df$module, levels = c("other", "labeled"))
  
  # Set unlabeled genes to NAs to avoid labeling them, speeds up plotting as well
  temp1 = subset(df, module != "labeled")
  temp1$two.gene = NA
  temp2 = subset(df, module != "labeled")
  temp2$one.gene = NA
  
  new_df = rbind(subset(df, module == "labeled"), 
                 temp1, temp2)
  
  # Flow plot
  plt = ggplot(new_df, aes(y = Count, axis1 = one.gene, axis2 = two.gene)) +
      geom_flow(aes(fill = module), width=width, curve_type = "cubic", alpha = alpha, fill = color) +
      geom_stratum(width = width, fill = colors, size=0, alpha = 1) +
      ylab("Genes") + 
      theme(axis.ticks.x = element_blank(), panel.background = element_blank(),
            panel.grid.major = element_blank(), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())+
      geom_text(stat = "stratum", aes(label = after_stat(stratum)), size = 0) +
      scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, nrow(df)))+
      scale_x_discrete(expand=c(0,0), labels = networks)
  
  return(plt)
}
```

```{r preservation analysis, echo=FALSE}
enableWGCNAThreads(nThreads = parallel::detectCores() - 4)

allowWGCNAThreads()


results$permutation.test = PreservationPermutationTest(seasonal_networks$combined@datExpr[,], 
                                                       sampleTable, 
                                                       constructNetworksIn = "SD", # Construct networks using SD samples
                                                       testPreservationIn = "n2a", # Test preservation of disease samples in WT samples
                                                       nPermutations = 10, # Number of permutations for permutation test
                                                       nPresPermutations = 10, # Number of permutations for modulePreservation function
                                                       
                                                       # WGCNA parameters for re-sampled networks (should be the same as used for network construction)
                                                       networkType = "signed hybrid", TOMType = "unsigned", 
                                                       power = 5, minModuleSize = 10, maxBlockSize = 25000,
                                                       reassignThreshold = 0, minKMEtoStay = 0, mergeCutHeight = 0,
                                                       numericLabels = TRUE, pamRespectsDendro = FALSE, 
                                                       deepSplit = 4, verbose = 3
                                                       )
```

```{r, eval = TRUE}
# Remove outlier modules
permutationTestResultsFiltered = lapply(permutationTestResults, function(x) x[!x$is.outlier.module,])

# Extract the preservation score distribution                                                       
results$scores.summary = PreservationScoreDistribution(permutationTestResultsFiltered, 
                                                       moduleOfInterestSize = 303 # The size of the module of interest (dM15)
)

# Observed preservation score of dM15
observed.score =-1.0352035

# How many times did we observe a score lower than or equal to this observed score?
z.summary.dist = results$scores.summary$z.summary
below=length(z.summary.dist[z.summary.dist <= observed.score])
probability= below/100
message("Probability of observing a score of ", round(observed.score, 2), " is ", probability)
```

```{r, eval = TRUE}
# Plot on a histogram
ggplot(results$scores.summary, aes(x=z.summary)) + 
      geom_histogram(color="black", fill="white", bins = 15)+
      xlab("Preservation score")+
      ylab("Frequency")+
      geom_vline(xintercept=observed.score, color="red3", linetype="solid")+
      scale_y_continuous(expand = c(0,0))+
      theme_classic()+
      theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))
```
